personality_one_liner: An immersive, cinematic nightlife and dating experience driven by liquid glass, deep contrast, and premium ruby accents.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards never flush to screen edges, use lg (16pt) margin. Thumb zone respected for primary CTAs.

do's: Use heavily for the floating Liquid Glass Tab Bar, Bottom Sheets, and Swipe Card overlays.
Pair blur with a translucent tinted base (>=75% opacity of surface in dark mode) to ensure foreground text is WCAG AAA readable.
Use on sticky top segmented headers when content scrolls beneath.
dont's: Never blur body text regions, form fields, or standard list rows.
Never apply glass without the underlying tint layer to guarantee contrast.

screens.name: Home Feed
screens.purpose: Curated discovery of clubs, events, and people nearby using large cinematic cards.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders with shimmer matching exact card dimensions.
states.empty: Premium glass empty state with Ruby-tinted Phosphor icon and 'Explore Nearby' CTA.
states.error: Elegant glass pane with a simple error message and a 'Retry' button, NO stack trace.

screens.layout: Top sticky segmented tabs (Tonight / Nearby / Map) with glassmorphism. Large edge-to-edge (minus lg margin) visual cards. Each card has a full-bleed background photo, mandatory 3-stop vertical gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surface), and frosted glass metadata pill at the bottom left.

screens.name: Swipe / Dating
screens.purpose: Tinder-style immersive profile exploration and matching.

states.loading: Full screen shimmer skeleton of the photo and bottom card.
states.empty: Abstract blurred glass background with 'No more profiles nearby' message.
states.error: Readable error message over an abstract background.

screens.layout: Full-bleed profile photo behind the safe area. A frosted glass card floats in the bottom 30% containing name, age, and bio. Circular glass control buttons (Rewind, Pass, Super Like, Like) float above the tab bar. Text layered on photo MUST use the 3-stop gradient scrim.

screens.name: Profile

states.empty: Empty grid state with 'Share a moment' CTA.

screens.layout: Instagram-style header with integrated avatar, followed by separated Apple-style Glass cards for stats and bio. A seamless 3-column grid for 'Moments'. Sticky glass header on scroll.

screens.name: Settings
screens.layout: Organized categories (Account, Security, Notifications, Appearance) using iOS 26 style grouped lists. surfaceSecondary for row backgrounds, sm or md radius, internal dividers only, right chevrons, and native system toggles. No full-width borders.

club_hero_card.alt: people partying inside room with red neon lighting

instructions_to_main_agent: NUCLEAR COLOR RULE: Remove all instances of the previous violet/purple (#8B5CF6). Implement the new Premium Ruby (#E11D48) as the primary brand color to match the Glass/Luxe nightlife aesthetic. Do not use any blues, purples, or indigo.
Implement a true Dark Mode as the default premium experience (Surface: #09090B), alongside a refined Light Mode (Surface: #FFFFFF, Secondary: #F4F4F5). Do not simply invert colors.

MANDATORY SCRIM: Whenever text sits on top of an image (e.g., Home club cards, Swipe dating cards), you MUST insert a 3-stop vertical `expo-linear-gradient` (transparent -> 20% surfaceInverse -> 80%+ surfaceInverse) between the image and the text. Without this, contrast fails.
Liquid Glass Tab Bar: The bottom tab bar must be floating (margins on sides and bottom) and utilize `expo-blur` with a translucent tint. Ensure safe areas are respected beneath it.

Animations & Micro-interactions: Use `react-native-reanimated` for spring interactions on buttons (scale down to 0.96 on press), swipe gestures for Tinder cards, and smooth bottom sheet drag indicators.
Settings Screen: Model exactly after iOS Apple Settings. Use grouped list rows (`surfaceSecondary`), grouped border radii, and internal subtle dividers. Do not reinvent the settings layout.
Skeleton Loaders: Never show a blank white screen. All loading states must use a shimmer effect over shapes that match the final loaded content (e.g., full card shapes, circular avatars).
